fields.Name: T379 - Reset Layout To Default
fields.Description: Exercises onResetLayout rebuilding a fresh single-tab workspace configuration (CreateDefaultTab + UpdateConfiguration) — a workspace-state reset path no other test triggers.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. First open a couple of extra tabs (e.g. open two entities via the LEFT sidebar 'Search entities...' box) so the current app has multiple tabs. Then click the user avatar button in the TOP-RIGHT corner to open the user menu and choose the 'Reset Layout' item. Verify the workspace resets so the current app shows just its single default tab (the extra tabs are gone) and the app is still usable. Seeing the layout collapse back to a fresh single default tab is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Multiple tabs are open before the reset
A 'Reset Layout' option is available in the user menu and is clickable
After reset, the current app shows a single default tab (extra tabs removed) and remains functional
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
